item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00353","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C08","C11","C22"],"selected_candidate_label":"C08","confidence":0.83,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C08 is a close reusable termination-proclamation template: it identifies an earlier proclamation, recites the statutory authority to terminate it, establishes that the conditions for termination have arisen, and then terminates the earlier proclamation as of a specified date. The child follows the same operative sequence and closely similar phrasing, adapted from a Haitian trade agreement to a New Zealand copyright-time extension. C11 provides a similar but slightly less complete termination pattern. C22 shares the child's specific copyright-extension machinery and terminology, but it grants rather than terminates an extension.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas the said section 9 of title 17 of the United States Code authorizes the President to terminate any such proclamation at any time","parent_excerpt":"Whereas the said section 350(a) of the Tariff Act of 1930, as amended, authorizes the President to terminate any proclamation carrying out a trade agreement entered into under such section","explanation":"Both expressly recite statutory authority to terminate an earlier proclamation."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the aforesaid [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of April 24, 1947, and the extension of time granted thereby, shall terminate on December 29, 1950","parent_excerpt":"do proclaim that the said proclamation dated May 4, 1935, is hereby terminated as of the close of December 31, 1949","explanation":"The operative clauses use substantially the same mechanism: identify the prior proclamation and terminate it on a fixed date."},{"child_excerpt":"extension of time for compliance with the conditions and formalities prescribed by the copyright laws ... because of the disruption or suspension of the facilities essential to such compliance","parent_excerpt":"the time within which compliance with such conditions and formalities may take place is hereby extended ... such disruption or suspension of facilities essential to compliance","explanation":"C22 supplies highly specific copyright-extension vocabulary echoed in the child's description of the measure being terminated."}]}
